title: Bug bash: carrier admin console
story: As the sponsor I want every admin section to load and save without errors
acceptance: Every defect assigned to area 'admin' is fixed with a regression test, or explained
Audit clean on admin screens for both tenants
Full npm test: no new failures
brief: Defect list comes from the audit phase.

verdicts.reason: Admin area is otherwise demo-ready (both tenants, port 18704). All 9 sections load with no console errors or failed API calls. GET /config/versions works and history shows 'Taylor Brandt' / 'System (tenant file)' and readable section names. The save preview shows 'AI settings > Token budget per claim'. Only one toast appears. The webhook secret panel stays until the admin confirms. There is no sideways scroll at 390px, and save/diff work on mobile. tests/ui/admin.test.mjs passes 15/15 and tests/unit/web/admin passes. BLOCKER (criterion 3, full npm test, no new failures): in the current tree, your own new test tests/unit/config/versions-public.test.mjs:45 'GET /config/public marks lines a claimant cannot use on the web (Kestrel)' fails. It asserts availableLobs == [] for a Kestrel claimant. S6-BUG-05 (in progress, owns tenants/) has added claimant_web to Kestrel personal_auto so the claimant auto demo can work, so the API correctly returns ['personal_auto']. Fix it inside your paths: make the expectation come from the tenant's lob channels, or use a fixture config instead of the live tenant file, so the test stops encoding another ticket's tenant data. Also update the hub note to the experience hub that says 'Kestrel claimant_web -> []'. Other full-suite failures are not yours: routes snapshot drift (event-types, agent roles), S6-BUG-01 and S6-BUG-02. The earlier admin webhook UI failures came from S6-BUG-05's event-type allow-list and are resolved by its claim.created alias. Optional polish: the empty Default queue select should show a 'Platform chooses' label, and the rule hint 'Queues you can route to' lists raw queue ids instead of labels.
